The Reference agent explicitly asks "¿En qué más te puedo ayudar hoy?" (Is there anything else I can help you with today?), serving as a courtesy check and offering further assistance. The Actual agent omits this follow-up question, instead ending with an enthusiastic statement ("Estamos muy emocionados de ver lo que este talentoso dúo puede lograr en la pista."). This constitutes a slight change in the conversational flow and a minor omission compared to the reference, aligning with a "Mostly Consistent" score.
